sentences.text: Wyoming -LSB- waɪˈoʊmɪŋ -RSB- is a state in the mountain region of the western United States .	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	mountain region	Mountain States	United States	United States

The state is the tenth largest by area , the least populous and the second least densely populated state in the country .	tenth largest by area	List of U.S. states and territories by area	least populous	List of U.S. states and territories by population	second least densely populated state	List of U.S. states by population density

Wyoming is bordered on the north by Montana , on the east by South Dakota and Nebraska , on the south by Colorado , on the southwest by Utah , and on the west by Idaho .	South Dakota	South Dakota	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	Montana	Montana	Nebraska	Nebraska	Colorado	Colorado	Utah	Utah	Idaho	Idaho
Cheyenne is the capital and the most populous city in Wyoming , with a population estimate of 63,335 in 2015 .	Cheyenne	Cheyenne, Wyoming	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)
The state population was estimated at 586,107 in 2015 , which is less than the population of 31 of the largest U.S. cities .	largest U.S. cities	List of United States cities by population

The western two-thirds of the state is covered mostly with the mountain ranges and rangelands in the Rocky Mountains , while the eastern third of the state is high elevation prairie known as the High Plains .	Rocky Mountains	Rocky Mountains	High Plains	High Plains (United States)

Almost half of the land in Wyoming is owned by the U.S. government , leading Wyoming to rank sixth in the United States in total acres and fifth in percentage of a state 's land owned by the federal government .	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	United States	United States	U.S. government	Federal government of the United States

The federal lands include two national parksGrand Teton and Yellowstonetwo national recreation areas and two national monuments , as well as several national forests , historic sites , fish hatcheries , and wildlife refuges .
The Crow , Arapaho , Lakota , and Shoshone were some of the original inhabitants of the region .	Crow	Crow Nation	Arapaho	Arapaho	Lakota	Lakota people	Shoshone	Shoshone

Southwestern Wyoming was included in the Spanish Empire and then Mexican territory until it was ceded to the United States in 1848 at the end of the Mexican -- American War .	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	United States	United States	Spanish Empire	Spanish Empire

The region acquired the name Wyoming when a bill was introduced to Congress in 1865 to provide a `` temporary government for the territory of Wyoming . ''	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	the territory of Wyoming	Wyoming Territory

The territory was named after the Wyoming Valley in Pennsylvania , with the name ultimately being derived from the Munsee word xwé : wamənk , meaning `` at the big river flat . ''	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	Wyoming Valley	Wyoming Valley	Pennsylvania	Pennsylvania	Munsee	Munsee language

The mineral-extraction industryespecially coal , oil , natural gas , and tronaalong with the travel and tourism sector , are the main drivers behind Wyoming 's economy .	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	natural gas	natural gas

Agriculture has historically been an important component of the state economy with the main commodities being livestock -LRB- beef -RRB- , hay , sugar beets , grain -LRB- wheat and barley -RRB- , and wool .	hay	hay	wool	wool

The climate is generally semi-arid and continental , being drier and windier in comparison to the rest of the United States , with greater temperature extremes .	United States	United States	semi-arid	Semi-arid climate	continental	continental climate

Except for the 1964 election , Wyoming has been a politically conservative state since the 1950s , with the Republican party winning every presidential election .	Wyoming	Wyoming (song)	1964 election	U.S. presidential election, 1964	Republican party	Republican Party (United States)
